rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for openly expressing disapproval or objecting to something.

example.english: When I saw someone littering, I decided to remonstrate.
example.traditional: 我見到有人亂咁掉垃圾，就即刻出聲反對。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 lyun6 gam3 diu6 laap6 saap3 zau6 zik1 hak1 ceot1 seng1 faan2 deoi3

rows.note: Use this when the objection is presented as a formal protest or official complaint.

example.english: The residents went to the management office to remonstrate about the noise problem.
example.traditional: 居民就噪音問題去管理處抗議。
example.jyutping: geoi1 man4 zau6 cou3 jam1 man6 tai4 heoi3 gun2 lei5 cyu3 kong3 ji5

rows.note: Use this when remonstrating means arguing back directly with a person about their unreasonable behaviour.

example.english: I don't want to remonstrate with you; think it through yourself first.
example.traditional: 我唔想同你理論，你自己諗清楚先啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 lei5 leon6 nei5 zi6 gei2 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 laa1
